prep.intro: A colleague at work is leaving to take a new job, and the team wants to buy her a leaving gift. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each idea below.
content: A framed photo of the whole team
A gift card for a restaurant
A house plant for her new home
A weekend trip voucher
A donation to a charity she cares about

prompt: Now decide together which idea would be the best leaving gift.

prep.intro: A local school is planning a day trip for a class of teenagers and is considering these destinations. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: A science museum
A theme park
A nature reserve with guided walks
A historic castle
An art gallery with a workshop

prompt: Now decide together which destination would be the best choice for the class trip.

prep.intro: A family wants to reduce the amount of plastic waste they produce at home and is considering these changes. Talk together about how easy or difficult each one would be.
content: Buying food without plastic packaging
Using refillable bottles and containers
Switching to bar soap and shampoo
Composting food waste instead of using bin bags
Choosing second-hand items instead of new ones

prompt: Now decide together which change would make the biggest difference for this family.

prep.intro: A group of friends is organising entertainment for a big family party and is considering these options. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: Hiring a live band
Setting up a photo booth
Organising party games for all ages
Booking a magician or entertainer
Creating a shared playlist and letting guests choose songs

prompt: Now decide together which form of entertainment would work best for the party.

prep.intro: A small company has some extra money left in its budget this year and is considering how to spend it on the team. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each idea.
content: A team day out
New equipment for the office
A training course for staff
A bonus shared equally among everyone
Better coffee and snacks in the office

prompt: Now decide together which option would benefit the team the most.

prep.intro: A group of friends is planning a birthday party for a friend turning thirty and is considering these venues. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: A private room at a restaurant
A rented cabin in the countryside
A friend's back garden
A rooftop bar in the city centre
A community hall with a DJ

prompt: Now decide together which venue would be the best choice for the party.

prep.intro: A small office wants to help a new employee feel welcome in her first week and is considering these ideas. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: Assigning her a mentor from the team
Organising a welcome lunch with colleagues
Giving her a printed guide to office routines
Scheduling short meetings with each department
Leaving a small welcome gift on her desk

prompt: Now decide together which idea would help the new employee settle in best.

prep.intro: A neighbourhood association is organising a community festival and is considering these activities for the day. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: A live music stage
A food market with local vendors
Face painting and games for children
A sports tournament in the park
A craft fair for local artists

prompt: Now decide together which activity should be the main attraction at the festival.

prep.intro: Several residents in an apartment building are frustrated by constant noise and are considering these solutions. Talk together about how effective each one would be.
content: Setting agreed quiet hours in the evening
Installing thicker carpets in shared hallways
Holding a residents' meeting to discuss the issue
Asking the building manager to send a formal notice
Fitting extra soundproofing in the walls

prompt: Now decide together which solution would work best for reducing the noise.

prep.intro: A local council has a small budget to improve a neighbourhood and is considering these projects. Talk together about the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
content: Planting trees along the main street
Repairing the cracked pavements
Installing benches in the local park
Adding better lighting near the bus stop
Building a small playground for children

prompt: Now decide together which project would benefit the neighbourhood the most.
